description: APD Computer Aided Dispatch Incidents is published by City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. APD CAD records distinguish incoming calls from officer-initiated incidents and include response timing. Its stated coverage is Austin, United States; police dispatch incidents. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is Public Domain. The provider excludes cancelled records according to its documented rules. For simulation, it can inform emergency-response planning and comparisons of demand against available resources; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-jemss provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
